selection_rule: per arm: max mean macro-F1 over clean VAL and VAL-swap (tie-break lower ECE); wild reporting only. Probabilities temperature-scaled on VAL + VAL-swap.

sets.wild: all disease-labelled wild images (Mendeley CC BY sets)
sets.wild_test: wild_test half only (never used by Phase 2 either)

small_sample_warning: wild CIs rest on 125 labelled images (55 turmeric / 70 black gram; wild_test about half of that) from two Bangladeshi datasets: treat them as unreliable
